sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Use familiar forms together in short, meaningful exchanges.

Mi ez? and Ez a könyvem. are exactly the kind of exchange you'd actually use pointing at something new — asking 'what is this?' and answering with a possessive is far more natural in conversation than reciting a paradigm. Notice how the question word (Mi) and the answer (Ez a...) both lean on ez/az, the same demonstrative you've been using since Unit 1, now put to work alongside possession.
